title: Components opt into OnPush change detection
statement: Every `@Component` sets `changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush`. A component omitting it falls back to the default strategy, which re-checks the whole subtree on any event anywhere in the app.
rationale: The editor view has a stated hard performance goal ('rock-solid, extremely fast'). Default change detection walks every component's template on every zone event, which does not scale as panels (explorer, editor, review-panel) grow; OnPush plus signal-based state (QS-NG-010) checks a component only when its own inputs or signals actually change.

good.caption: Explicit OnPush.

bad.caption: changeDetection omitted: silently falls back to full-subtree default checking.

changelog.summary: Initial rule, grounded in the review panel's explicit OnPush and the product's stated editor performance goal.
